summary: Premium Catering (Holdings) Ltd, a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, disclosed a September 4, 2026 Nasdaq Staff Delinquency Letter citing non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after failing to timely file a Form 6-K containing interim financials for the half year ended December 31, 2025. The company has 60 calendar days to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, Nasdaq may extend up to 180 days from the report's due date, or December 28, 2026. Shares continue trading under 'PC' with no immediate suspension. Watch for the plan's acceptance, appeal risk, or eventual delisting proceedings.
